tools.name: execute_sap2000_code
tools.title: Execute C# in SAP2000
tools.description: Runs a C# script against the SAP2000 27 model the HPSap2000 MCP Bridge app is attached to (SAP2000v1 API). Globals: sapModel (cSapModel), sap (cOAPI), units (forced to kN_m_C for the run: m, kN, kN·m, kN/m²; restored after), ct, log(string), progress(cur,total,msg), args (args.Str/Int/Double/Bool(key, fallback)). OAPI calls return int: check ret, throw InvalidOperationException($"SAP2000 returned {ret} from X"); bad inputs → ArgumentException. End with `return <value>;`. No transaction or undo. Tiers, decided statically from `sapModel.X.Member(...)` chains (an alias, cast, ?., lambda or argument of a global = D): R read-only (Get*/Is*/Has*/Count/RefreshView/all of sapModel.Results/GetTableForDisplayArray; transaction=none). W write (other members; transaction=auto): the bridge saves your model and copies a .SDB snapshot first (`snapshot` names it); unsaved or UNC models are refused; rolledBack:false after an exception means the changes persisted. D destructive (SetModelIsLocked, RunAnalysis, DeleteResults, OpenFile/New*/Save, ApplyEditedTables, Start*/Modify*/Merge*/Reset*/Clear*/Rename*/Show*/Export*/Import*/Delete*, any path-taking member): needs 'Allow destructive operations' in the bridge window, else error -32001; up to 600 s. dryRun or transaction=none on a writing script = static preview (nothing runs; PREVIEW lists the members); manual = auto; changed counts additions/deletions only. cancel/timeout cannot interrupt a running SAP2000 call; the save counts against the timeout. Paths: a literal or args.Str("key") under the model folder or %LocalAppData%\HPSap2000, never UNC; every path-shaped args string is screened. No Helper/ApplicationExit/dialogs/#r/#load. Needs 'Allow AI code execution' in the HPSap2000 MCP Bridge window (a separate app, not inside SAP2000).

code.description: C# script body, max 32 KB. No `await`, no System.IO / System.Net / reflection / expression trees / interop, no Helper or application lifecycle calls, no dialogs (blocked by the guard).

transaction.description: auto (default): writing script — the bridge saves the model and takes a .SDB snapshot before running. none: read-only; a script that writes is refused with a PREVIEW diagnostic. manual: accepted for compatibility, behaves like auto.

dryRun.description: Static preview for a writing script (nothing runs; the PREVIEW diagnostic lists what it would call); a read-only script runs normally. Refused for destructive members.

timeoutSeconds.description: Cooperative timeout in seconds, 5–120 (up to 600 while destructive operations are allowed). Checked between OAPI calls only — a running RunAnalysis/Save/OpenFile cannot be interrupted.

label.description: Short name for the audit log and the snapshot file name. Max 64 characters; letters, digits, _ and - survive, the rest becomes _.

args.description: Optional JSON object handed to the script as `args` (e.g. {"frame": "12", "section": "W14X90"}). Keys are matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: draw_frame_by_coords
tools.title: Draw a frame by coordinates
tools.description: Adds one straight frame object between (x1, y1, z1) and (x2, y2, z2) in metres, optionally with a section and a user name. Returns the generated unique frame name. Writes the model: the bridge saves it and takes a .SDB snapshot first. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

name.description: Optional user label for the frame

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: get_structural_objects
tools.title: Get structural objects
tools.description: Pages through the frame, area or point objects: unique name, the frame section, end points or vertices in m and the frame length in m. Filter by group or by a substring of the name. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

group.description: Only objects in this group (exact group name)

nameLike.description: Only objects whose unique name contains this text (case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–500)

tools.name: get_run
tools.title: Get a past run
tools.description: Details of one run from the history (runId comes back from the execute tool, run_tool and test_tool): outcome, args, the code when it was a successful ad-hoc script, and — when the host application is reachable — an analysis listing hard-coded literals (line, value, variable) and the args keys already read. Use it before propose_tool to decide which literals become parameters.

analyze.description: Analyse the code (guard, compile, literals) through the host application

tools.name: get_sap2000_context
tools.title: Get SAP2000 context
tools.description: Returns the SAP2000 session the bridge app is attached to: hostVersion (27), docTitle and docPath of the model file (absent while no model is open or it was never saved), isModifiable (attached, a model is open, SAP2000 is idle — no dialog open), units.length (m: every run forces kN_m_C), executionEnabled, and sap2000 {isAttached, attachedPid, oapiVersion, isLocked (definitions cannot change until unlocked — unlocking discards results), presentUnits (the user's own API units), databaseUnits, destructiveOperationsEnabled (the second opt-in: unlock, RunAnalysis, file operations), pointCount, frameCount, areaCount}. With includeSelection the selected objects come back (max 50) as {id, category = object type, name}. Fails fast with a busy error while a script is running, with 'not attached' until the user clicks Attach in the HPSap2000 MCP Bridge window, and with 'no model' on the SAP2000 start screen. Call this before execute_sap2000_code so the script matches the real model and its lock state.

includeSelection.description: Include the objects currently selected in SAP2000 (max 50: id = running index, category = object type (Point/Frame/Area/…), name = object unique name).

tools.name: get_materials_and_sections
tools.title: Get materials and frame sections
tools.description: Lists the material properties (type, E in MPa, Poisson ratio, thermal coefficient, G in MPa) and the frame section properties (shape type, area in m², I22/I33 in m⁴, S/Z in m³, radii of gyration in m) defined in the model. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Property, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–500)

tools.name: get_frame_forces
tools.title: Get frame member forces
tools.description: Returns internal forces along frame objects for a load case or combination: axial P, shears V2/V3 in kN, torsion T, bending moments M2/M3 in kN·m, at output stations in m. Filter by frame names. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Results, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

frameNames.description: Specific frame names (empty returns all frames)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–500)

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.title: Get model info
tools.description: Overview of the SAP2000 model the bridge is attached to: file name and folder, lock state, present and database units, SAP2000 version, object counts (points, frames, areas) and optionally defined groups. Call it first: every script works in kN and m whatever the model's units. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Model, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

includeGroups.description: Also list defined groups in the model

tools.name: get_coordinate_systems_and_grids
tools.title: Get coordinate systems and grid lines
tools.description: Lists coordinate systems defined in the SAP2000 model (origin in m, angles in degrees) and their grid lines (IDs, coordinates in m, visibility). Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

includeGridLines.description: Include individual grid line IDs and coordinates

annotations.title: Get coordinate systems and grid lines

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.title: Cancel running script
tools.description: Signals cancellation to the script currently running in the host application. Cancellation is cooperative: the script stops at its next `ct` check, and its transaction group is rolled back. Returns whether anything was running.

tools.name: get_joint_reactions
tools.title: Get joint reactions
tools.description: Returns support reactions for a load case or combination: F1, F2, F3 in kN, M1, M2, M3 in kN·m. Filter by point names. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Results, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

pointNames.description: Specific point names (empty returns all joints)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–500)

tools.name: run_analysis
tools.title: Run the analysis
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: runs the SAP2000 analysis (all load cases, or only the ones named) after optionally deleting existing results, and reports each case's status. Needs the user's 'Allow destructive operations' checkbox in the bridge window on every call. Choose timeoutSeconds from the last analysis time in the SAP2000 GUI (up to 600): a timeout does not abort the analysis — SAP2000 keeps running it and later calls answer busy until it finishes. The model is saved and a .SDB snapshot copied first; results of a run cannot be undone. [Registry tool v1, Analysis, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

cases.description: Only run these load cases — the run flags of the others are switched off and stay off in the model until changed; default every case

deleteResultsFirst.description: Delete all existing results before running

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.title: Run a registry tool
tools.description: Run a stored tool from the registry with the given args (must match its inputSchema from search_tools / get_tool). Same result shape as the execute tool. Draft / tested / pending tools need allowUnpublished=true. Use dryRun=true first for tools that modify the document.

allowUnpublished.description: Allow running a tool that is not published yet

tools.name: assign_joint_restraint
tools.title: Assign joint restraints (supports)
tools.description: Assigns support boundary conditions to one or more points: fixed (all 6 DOFs), pinned (U1,U2,U3), roller (U3), free (all released), or custom (6 booleans). Writes the model: the bridge saves it and takes a .SDB snapshot first. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

restraints.description: 6 booleans [U1, U2, U3, R1, R2, R3] required when type is 'custom'

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: propose_tool
tools.title: Propose a new registry tool
tools.description: Package a working C# script as a reusable tool (status draft). Replace every literal that may change between calls with args.<Kind>("key") and declare each key in inputSchema (JSON Schema object: string/number/integer/boolean/array/object, required, default, description). The code is guard-checked and compiled inside the host application but not run. Give ≥ 2 examples with different args; test_tool runs them. Returns a validation report; fix errors and call again. Use newVersion=true to replace the code of an existing tool.

description.description: What the tool does, for search and for the reviewer (≥ 20 chars)

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the args object

code.description: Script body: same globals as the execute tool plus args; must end with return

title.description: Human title, e.g. 'Colour beams by type'

transaction.description: auto (the bridge wraps the run in a transaction) | manual (Revit: the code opens its own Transaction; AutoCAD: same as auto) | none (read-only)

sourceRunId.description: runId of the execute run this comes from (see get_run)

newVersion.description: Propose a new version of an existing tool name

tools.name: assign_frame_section
tools.title: Assign a frame section
tools.description: Assigns one frame section property to the given frame objects (unique names). Writes the model: the bridge saves it and copies a .SDB snapshot first; SAP2000 has no undo. Frames SAP2000 refuses are listed in errors. [Registry tool v1, Property, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: publish_tool
tools.title: Publish a registry tool
tools.description: Request publication of a tested tool. Policy manual (default): the tool becomes pending_approval, a review file is written and a human must run the server's `registry approve <name>` command (`<server>.exe registry --help`; or set status=published in tool.json). Policy auto: tested tools publish immediately. Published tools appear in tools/list of every running server.

tools.name: assign_frame_load
tools.title: Assign load to frame objects
tools.description: Assigns a distributed load (kN/m) or a point load (kN at relative position 0–1) to frame objects under a load pattern. Direction 1–3 local, 4–11 global (default 10 = Gravity / -Z global). Writes the model: the bridge saves it and takes a .SDB snapshot first. [Registry tool v1, Load, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

frameNames.description: Unique names of the target frames

valueKNperM.description: Distributed load magnitude in kN/m (required if loadType='distributed')

valueKN.description: Point load magnitude in kN (required if loadType='point')

relativePosition.description: Position along the frame as a fraction 0–1 (point loads only)

direction.description: 1–3 local axes, 4–6 global X/Y/Z, 7–9 projected, 10 gravity (-Z), 11 projected gravity

replace.description: Replace existing loads on this pattern (false to add)

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: inspect_type
tools.title: Inspect a host API type
tools.description: Reflects over an API type loaded in the running host application (Revit or AutoCAD) and returns its public members as C#-like signatures (kind: property | method | field | event). Use it to confirm exact method names and parameters before writing a script.

typeName.description: Type name, e.g. 'Wall' or 'FilteredElementCollector' in Revit, 'Polyline' or 'LayerTableRecord' in AutoCAD, or a fully qualified name such as 'Autodesk.Revit.DB.Structure.Rebar'.

memberFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to keep only matching member names, e.g. 'Create'.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: test_tool
tools.title: Test a registry tool
tools.description: Run a tool's examples (or the given cases) inside the host application with dryRun — every change is rolled back — and record the outcomes. All cases passing moves a draft to tested. realRun=true commits the changes (only on a scratch model).

cases.description: Optional cases [{"title": "...", "args": {...}}]; default = the tool's examples

tools.name: manage_tool
tools.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool
tools.description: deprecate: retire a tool (never runs again until restored). quarantine: pull it from tools/list. restore: back to draft so it can be tested and published again.

annotations.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get a registry tool
tools.description: Full record of one stored tool: metadata, input schema, examples, C# code (optional), run statistics and recent runs.

recentRuns.description: How many recent runs to include (0–50)

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the tool registry
tools.description: Search the registry of stored tools for this host (Revit or AutoCAD) BEFORE writing code with the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code). Full-text over name, description, tags and examples, ranked by relevance × stability × status. Returns each tool's inputSchema so it can be called directly by name (published tools are real MCP tools) or through run_tool. Empty query lists tools (optionally by category).

query.description: What you want to do, in any language, e.g. 'tạo lưới trục', 'color beams by type', 'room schedule'

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

includeUnpublished.description: Also return draft / tested / pending tools (they need allowUnpublished=true in run_tool)

tools.name: get_load_definitions
tools.title: Get load definitions
tools.description: Lists the load patterns (type, self-weight multiplier), the load cases (type, sub-type) and the load combinations (type and, on request, the cases with their scale factors). Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Load, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside SAP2000 — prefer them over execute_sap2000_code for the same task.]

includeComboCases.description: Also list each combination's cases and scale factors

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–500)
